scope: Independent reading of final public apparatus, starter/completed shortcut/oracle/reference, tests, validator, author/history, prototype and existing reports. Hash/schema checks only; no new scientific calculations, model trials or task edits.

physics_review.finding: Explicit (g,e) Hamiltonian, spontaneous radiative vacuum decay, stationary preparation and independently repeated finite gates define the emitter. The fluorescence-only port excludes incident drive while retaining elastic emitter fluorescence. Broadband unfiltered detection, independent photon thinning and absent dead time/dark counts make the count variance unique.

Column-major Liouvillian has the correct commutator and lowering dissipator. Trace-constrained stationary state is correct. Symmetrized seed {n,rho}/2-p*rho is Hermitian, trace zero, and gives the connected population covariance. The two integration coordinates in the matrix exponential produce the required (duration-time) kernel. Adding shot noise to this population covariance is a coherent second-cumulant nondestructive-intensity closure; no complete positive classical counting process is claimed.

Emission-conditioned seed lowering*rho*raising-p*rho, final n contraction and prefactor2*(efficiency*decay)^2 are correct. The same mean eta*Gamma*p*duration appears in both controls. Independent thinning implies Var(N_eta)=eta*Mean(N_1)+eta^2*(Var(N_1)-Mean(N_1)), consistent with the code.

Reference directly evolves three 2x2 factorial-moment matrices, with source k*eta*Gamma*lowering*rho[k-1]*raising and analytic stationary coherence. Its mean is Tr(rho1), variance Tr(rho2)+mean-mean^2. It does not reuse oracle vectorization or integrated covariance. Prototype tilted moment-generating/Cauchy derivatives, count-resolved blocks and resonant regression provide distinct checks.

Known positive mean-count coefficients multiply the sole unknown efficiency, so the weighted objective has positive constant curvature and unique bounded fit. All24 mean settings exercise drive, detuning, decay and duration. Calibration is exactly insensitive to the covariance conditioning. Shot noise, counts, their variance and efficiency are dimensionless in the stated common time unit.

input_and_grading.public_exclusions: Necessary detector/background and bath definitions; no conditioned-jump seed, antibunching label, count-correlation recipe or private truth is exposed.
input_and_grading.docker_boundary: Only README/starter/public-test/calibration copied; oracle/reference/hidden cases/hint/AUTHOR remain private.
input_and_grading.grading: Numeric shape/finiteness/calibration/parameter and mean anchors plus three variance groups; no source inspection or model-form mandate.

identifiability.basis: A known positive mean-count basis times one efficiency; weighted least squares has a strictly positive constant Hessian.

existing_validation_review.history: The documented pre-freeze private validator tuple-abs bug was fixed before the final report; physics/data/grading were unchanged. Final report is finite and all expected controls complete.

overlap_and_classification.overlap: Related quantum photon/noise topics exist, but dressed-photodetection concerns an interacting transition basis and triad-photon-phase concerns interference. This task addresses finite-gate emission counting versus nondestructive population-noise interpretation. No claim of an independent theoretical principle or prior empirical difficulty.
overlap_and_classification.intended_physical_failure: Retaining symmetrized population fluctuations as actual emission-count covariance.
overlap_and_classification.nonphysical_failure: Recognizing emission conditioning but misimplementing its regression, prefactor, matrix convention or integration. Full trial trajectory and fixed-parameter diagnosis are required to distinguish them.
